note: Thresholds are fixed before the graded trial. They are not relaxed after the pictures come back.
trisNote: Scene triangle count is the branch-head budget from test-cpu, 195634, which is the run-31 number. It must not move.

key.snow: The four live snow stills, pooled. Exposure is fixed so snow-pixel p50 matches that p50 within lumaDeltaMax.
key.frame: The run-31 gamma-2.2 frame at the same time is the frame key. Full-frame luma p1, p50, and p99 must each stay within lumaDeltaMax of that frame. A gameplay frame is not a flat still, so snow p1 and p99 are reported and are not the pass line.
key.keyscore: 100 - (CIE76 snow median vs snow stills + CIE76 ice median vs glacier-ice stills) / 2. Higher is better. The floor is run31Keyscore, measured on the baseline frames and written before the graded trial.

greyBright: Among ice pixels (fall, arch, icicle, wall, serac) with display luma above brightLuma, the fraction whose max-min is below greyChroma.
iceBlue: Mean (b - r) over those ice pixels. Must be above iceBlueMin.
crushed: Fraction of pixels that are not the planet and have luma below crushAt.
